title: Tim Knight Breaks Down the Three Things That Made Him Short China
speaker: Tim Knight

macro_themes.view: Chinese large caps and the Hang Seng are in a long downtrend of lower highs, uncorrelated to US politics.

calls.reason: Repeated rounded-top-then-drop history, broken 20-year support trend line now acting as resistance, and low correlation to US election noise; a half-year-plus trade.
calls.quote: it could be well into February or sometime early next year when uh I believe it could reach my target, which is something like down …

notes: Hang Seng index shown as supporting chart (bearish, descending trend line); not recorded separately. No date stated; listing Oct 5.
